demo.title: watch.sh
demo.code:
# Scan the latest Bankr launches on Base and Robinhood Chain
bankr prompt "Run the bankr-launch-judge watch on the latest 50 launches. Update the case ledger. Facts only."

# Judge one token
bankr prompt "Judge Bankr token 0xADDRESS on robinhood as rug, vapor, slow cook, or diamond with confidence. Compare to prior cases."

# Re-review a serial deployer
bankr prompt "Re-open every case from deployer 0xWALLET and report the pattern."

setup: Install from GitHub: install the bankr-launch-judge skill from https://github.com/kyleisboredrn-glitch/bankr-launch-judge
Copy assets/case-ledger.json or start a fresh /cases/bankr-launch-judge/ledger.json on the Bankr filesystem
Optional: install bankr-token-scam-analysis for deeper holder forensics
Schedule in Bankr: every 2 hours, prompt in references/automation-prompt.md
